reference.adopted: Long training, additive objectives, persistent old-skill exposure. No teacher, scripted assistance, mechanism, noise ranges or gimbal ABI copied.

initialization: Fresh fully trainable six-output actor, critic and empty Adam. No checkpoint, teacher, donor, resume or scripted motor targets.

friction.provenance: Existing standard-prone baseline; engineering hypothesis, not measured hardware friction. DR preserves the requested ground0.3..0.5 range.

wheel_model.scope: Independent measured 15.62/24V left/right output axes, P0.5. Aggregate I/O delay once; existing v2 policy-observation age remains additional uncertainty. Shared body/armature inertia draw; no added randomization range. Loaded high-speed torque remains a prior.

gas_spring_model.scope: Same LEFT-measured axial force curve on both legs. Measured56..101deg points unchanged; positive C1 endpoint-trend extension covers soft40..107deg. Extrapolated regions remain unmeasured; physical and compensation calls share this law.

training_progression: One native learn(10000) call; continuous global iteration and ETA. Save every250 completed updates without cold tests. Only declared domain changes rebuild the physical environment before the next rollout's first observation/action, preserving the live actor/critic/Adam/storage/logger. After training, the operator selects any250-update snapshot or the10000-update final model for separate read-only review. Stop on explicit signal, nonfinite state or implementation failure. No automatic restart or resume.

evaluation.scope: Fixed final-target cases, including both signs2m/s, both actual body spins80..100rpm, four arc directions, three standing heights, and actual standard-prone completion followed by a full30s quiet window. Failure remains failure; no later suffix can replace the first window. This matrix does not qualify untested jumping/terrain/other fallen families or real hardware.
